articles.title: Michigan farmer protects his family’s 131 acres from future housing development
articles.summary: Michigan farmer John Boyer bought back his family’s 131 acres after the land changed hands over decades. In 2026, he sold its development rights to the Little Traverse Conservancy through a conservation easement, ensuring the property cannot be divided for housing or commercial development.
